your_skills_and_experience_we_re_interes.value:
Example 1: Fintech full-stack development. During my internship at Augur Talentcare, I developed full-stack features for a digital lending collections platform, including customer management, payment tracking and follow-up workflows. I built responsive user interfaces for customer records, collection dashboards and payment activities, delivering 8+ reusable components. I also designed and integrated backend services and REST APIs with structured error handling and implemented CRUD operations on customer and transaction data.

Example 2: AI-powered credit risk analytics. For my BankVision project, I developed a full-stack application using Python and Flask with machine learning integration. I engineered ensemble models using XGBoost, LightGBM and Random Forest, achieving 79.62% AUC with inference below 500 milliseconds. I built interactive dashboards with Tailwind CSS and Chart.js and integrated SHAP to make model predictions transparent.

Example 3: Cloud-based full-stack application. For the Campus Device Loan Management System, I built a responsive web interface using Vue.js 3 and TypeScript, connected to REST APIs and Azure Functions. I used Azure Cosmos DB and Azure Event Grid for data management and asynchronous communication, implemented authentication and authorisation, and supported a 99.9% availability target through structured error handling and monitoring.

Example 4: Fintech web application development. For the Collections Management System, I built a web application using React.js, Node.js, Express.js and MongoDB to digitise collection activities and payment workflows. I developed reusable frontend components and backend services, integrated secure authentication and REST APIs, and used Postman to test collection management features.

are_any_of_your_relatives_or_members_of_.questionLabel: Are any of your relatives or members of your household employed by the Company? Note: For purposes of this Application, the term "relatives" includes both "Immediate Family Members" and "Other Family Members." These are defined as follows: Immediate Family Members includes spouse, domestic partner, (step)parent, (step)child, (step)grandchild, (step)sibling, or a closely associated person who has assumed the responsibility normally shouldered by immediate family or for whom one has accepted such responsibility Other Family Members includes aunt, uncle, cousin, niece, nephew, parent-in-law, brother-in-law and sister-in-law Members of your household includes anyone who lives with you such as roommate or renter.

at_bny_we_remain_committed_to_equity_for.questionLabel: At BNY we remain committed to equity for all. do_you_an_immediate_family_member_or_an_.questionLabel: "Do you, an immediate family member, or an extended family member within your household have a personal investment in a “Covered Fund” as defined by the Volcker Rule? Applicants should also be aware that other holdings of Covered Funds over which they have indirect ownership or control will generally be attributed to them. For purposes of responding to the Covered Fund question, the term “immediate family members” includes an applicant’s spouse, domestic partner & unemancipated children (including stepchildren, foster children, sons-in-law or daughters-in-law), whether or not they live in the same household as the employee. In addition, “immediate family members” includes the following relatives who are living within the same household as the applicant: children (including stepchildren, foster children, sons-in-law & daughters-in-law), grandchildren, parents (including step-parents, mothers-in-law and fathers-in-law), grandparents, & siblings (including brothers-in-law, sisters-in-law & stepbrothers & stepsisters)."

to_ensure_appropriate_compliance_with_le.questionLabel: To ensure appropriate compliance with legal requirements and Oceaneering's Code of Business Conduct and Ethics, Applicants are required to disclose any situations that may involve conflicts of interest. A "conflict of interest" occurs when an Applicant's personal interests interfere, or appear to interfere, in any way with the best interests of Oceaneering. A conflict can arise as a result of an Applicant holding outside work or making financial investments that make it difficult to perform work for or on behalf of Oceaneering objectively and effectively. A conflict also can occur if an Applicant or an Applicant's extended family may or will receive personal benefits from a third party as a result of the Applicant's position and duties with Oceaneering or the award of business to Oceaneering, in the event that the Applicant accepts employment with Oceaneering.
